title: Page 76
transc:
Washington April 21 . 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Jennie for lent paradise itch bugs Vinton is your
whig coming sugar nick daily by wrangle period at
present orders stop Every thing coming up Attica and
send it to Animal but I have ordered a
large quantity of wherry which will be needed here
and Persia you are supplied should be allowed to
come here yoke Belcher oh for wings of dove
Thos T Eckert


Ft Monroe April 21 1864 
Maj Eckert Di
for Jacob Borgia unity dispatches in from bible unity walnut
Wallace has come come down Baden Windsor sunk plug shannon
disabled another Polker Flusser a very valuable officer is superb
zodiac she has passed Plymouth zebra My perfume uptons Plymouth
growl and Flora are well Garrisoned with all the Salem
I ought to spare them provisions mew nations & nuisance
zebra They ought to hold out & I have every
confidence they will unity perhaps this is intended as a
diversion unity any instructions sugar youth Knox Nelly my ducks
Geo D Sheldon


Maj Eckert Di  Monroe April 21 , 1864 
for Bender unity I understand that there are pebble veteran
Whartons Torch feeble oyster Ledham at Banjo coming to swindle
Maxim here zebra will you send them or shall we
send wherry star youth Knave Rosalie no more at present
Geo D Sheldon
